annotations.title: Get a run and its entries

description: Fetch a run. The owner reads the full run and its entries, open or sealed (pass api_key). Without the owner's key a sealed run returns its integrity view only: the hash chain, the whole-run fingerprint and whether the signature is valid, with no entry content.

api_key.description: Optional: your Bidda key. Needed to read the content of your own run, open or sealed.

name: get_run
